Iska har kona kitaab ke kone jaisa hai; aise kone ko right angle kehte hain. Is square ke saare kone ek jaise hain. Is square mein kul kitne right angle hain?

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Hawa mein tirchi hone se kona patla dikh sakta hai, par patang wahi square hai; kona dikhne se nahi, tester se jaancho. Tirchi udti square patang ke upar wale kone par tester ghuma kar rakho, toh kona kam khula hoga, bilkul fit, ya zyada khula?

Sahi jawab. Dekho, patang square hai, toh tirchi udne par bhi uska har kona right angle hai; ghuma kar rakha tester bilkul fit hoga. Ab woh kone dekhenge jo tester mein fit nahi hote, jaise cake ki nok, aur unhe right angle se milayenge. Yahan tak saaf hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan

Tester ka kona kone par, seedha kinaara bhuja par. Doosri bhuja seedhe kinaaron ke beech ho toh right angle se kam, doosre kinaare par toh barabar, paar ho toh zyada. Yeh cake ke tukde ki nok hai. Is par tester rakhoge, toh nok right angle se kam khuli niklegi ya zyada?
director.card: Yeh cake ke tukde ki nok hai. Is par tester rakhoge, toh nok right angle se kam khuli niklegi ya zyada?

director.text: zyada

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Zyada tab hota jab doosri bhuja tester ke doosre seedhe kinaare ke us paar jaati; board par dekho ki woh kahan se jaati hai. Board wali cake ki nok right angle se kam khuli hai, ya zyada khuli?
director.card: Yeh cake ke tukde ki nok hai. Is par tester rakhoge, toh nok right angle se kam khuli niklegi ya zyada?

director.text: zyada
Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Tester ka kona nok ke kone par aur ek seedha kinaara ek bhuja par socho, aur dekho ki doosri bhuja kahan se jaati hai. Chalo, ab tumhari baari.

Bilkul sahi: tester rakho toh doosri bhuja dono kinaaron ke beech jaayegi. Angle khulne se bada hota hai, bhujaon ki lambai se nahi. A ki bhujayein chhoti hain, B ki lambi, par tester rakho toh dono par bilkul fit hoga: dono barabar. Board par do angle dekho: ek ki bhujayein 6 cm, doosre ki 12 cm. Kaunsa zyada khula hai?

director.text: 6 cm wala hai

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 6 cm wala zyada khula hai, 12 cm wala kam. Darwaza aur deewar bhi ek angle banate hain. Darwaza thoda kholo toh angle chhota, aur zyada kholo toh angle bada ho jaata hai. Board par ek gate hai jo 2 m chauda hai, aur ek darwaza jo 1 m chauda hai; dono khule hain. Kiska angle bada hai, ya dono barabar hain?
